_meta.source_evidence: docs/research/error-profiles/pt.md §§2, 3, 6 and 7 (30 verb-regime plus 32 preposition/contraction rows)
_meta.format: Legacy es_verb_prep.json-compatible entries: verb, prep, pattern, en, trap, example_es, example_en
_meta.validation_notes: Brazilian Portuguese, professional register. For exact compatibility with the existing bank schema, example_es is the legacy target-sentence key and contains Portuguese. Ø marks a bare infinitive. Prescriptive assistir a is intentionally used for careful standard prose, with colloquial BR transitivity noted as a trap.

trap: Attested Italian calque tentar de; Portuguese takes a bare infinitive.
example_es: A equipe tentou resolver a falha antes do lançamento.
example_en: The team tried to solve the fault before launch.

trap: Attested Italian-style conseguir a; Portuguese takes a bare infinitive.
example_es: Os pesquisadores conseguiram reproduzir o resultado.
example_en: The researchers managed to reproduce the result.

trap: Attested decidir de is a Romance calque; use the bare infinitive.
example_es: O governo decidiu publicar os contratos.
example_en: The government decided to publish the contracts.

en: to be going to do something
trap: Attested Spanish calque vou a passar; the Brazilian periphrastic future has no a.
example_es: Vou revisar o episódio amanhã.
example_en: I am going to review the episode tomorrow.

trap: Do not insert de or a before the infinitive.
example_es: A empresa pretende ampliar o centro de dados.
example_en: The company intends to expand the data centre.

trap: Costumar is followed directly by the infinitive.
example_es: Os jornais costumam publicar projeções no domingo.
example_en: Newspapers usually publish projections on Sunday.

trap: Modal dever takes a bare infinitive.
example_es: O relatório deve explicar a metodologia.
example_en: The report should explain the methodology.

trap: Modal poder takes a bare infinitive.
example_es: A medida pode reduzir o consumo de energia.
example_en: The measure may reduce energy consumption.

en: to know how to do something
trap: In the ability sense, saber takes a bare infinitive.
example_es: A ferramenta sabe distinguir vozes diferentes.
example_en: The tool knows how to distinguish different voices.

trap: Querer takes a bare infinitive, not de or a.
example_es: Os eleitores querem entender a proposta.
example_en: Voters want to understand the proposal.

trap: Unlike English avoid + gerund, Portuguese uses the bare infinitive.
example_es: A regra evita expor dados pessoais.
example_en: The rule avoids exposing personal data.

trap: The standard infinitive complement is introduced by a.
example_es: A inflação começou a cair em maio.
example_en: Inflation began to fall in May.

trap: Voltar a + infinitive means resuming or repeating an action.
example_es: O Parlamento voltou a discutir a reforma.
example_en: Parliament discussed the reform again.

trap: The learned action is introduced by a.
example_es: A equipe aprendeu a usar o novo sistema.
example_en: The team learned to use the new system.

en: to teach someone to do something
trap: The action taught is introduced by a.
example_es: O curso ensina jornalistas a verificar imagens.
example_en: The course teaches journalists to verify images.

trap: Careful standard Portuguese uses a before the following infinitive.
example_es: A ferramenta ajuda os editores a localizar erros.
example_en: The tool helps editors locate errors.

en: to force someone to do something
trap: The required action follows a.
example_es: A decisão obrigou a empresa a rever o contrato.
example_en: The decision forced the company to review the contract.

en: to invite someone to do something
trap: The invited action is introduced by a.
example_es: A comissão convidou os especialistas a participar.
example_en: The committee invited the experts to participate.

trap: The activity follows a, not em or de.
example_es: Ela se dedica a estudar políticas digitais.
example_en: She devotes herself to studying digital policy.

trap: Pertencer governs a, which contracts with an article when needed.
example_es: O domínio pertence à universidade.
example_en: The domain belongs to the university.

trap: Careful standard Brazilian prose uses assistir a; colloquial BR often omits a.
example_es: Os senadores assistiram ao documentário.
example_en: The senators watched the documentary.

trap: Obedecer takes a, unlike transitive English obey.
example_es: O tratamento dos dados obedece à lei.
example_en: The processing of the data complies with the law.

trap: The question or criticism answered is introduced by a.
example_es: A ministra respondeu às críticas no plenário.
example_en: The minister answered the criticism in the chamber.

trap: The resource or authority follows a.
example_es: A empresa recorreu ao tribunal superior.
example_en: The company appealed to the higher court.

trap: The referent follows a, not sobre.
example_es: O artigo se refere a um estudo recente.
example_en: The article refers to a recent study.

trap: The target of opposition follows a.
example_es: Vários sindicatos se opõem à mudança.
example_en: Several unions oppose the change.

trap: The thing relinquished is introduced by a.
example_es: O diretor renunciou ao cargo ontem.
example_en: The director resigned from the post yesterday.

trap: Careful standard usage selects a for the destination; it contracts with articles.
example_es: A delegação chegou a Brasília pela manhã.
example_en: The delegation arrived in Brasília in the morning.

trap: English on and Spanish depender de can still trigger the wrong em in Portuguese.
example_es: O resultado depende de uma votação no Senado.
example_en: The result depends on a vote in the Senate.

trap: Gostar always requires de before its complement.
example_es: Os leitores gostam de comparar fontes diferentes.
example_en: Readers like comparing different sources.

trap: Standard Brazilian precisar in the need sense normally takes de.
example_es: A rede precisa de mais capacidade.
example_en: The network needs more capacity.

trap: Pronominal lembrar-se requires de; non-pronominal lembrar takes a direct object.
example_es: Lembre-se de salvar o arquivo.
example_en: Remember to save the file.

trap: Pronominal esquecer-se requires de; esquecer can be transitive.
example_es: O editor se esqueceu de anexar o gráfico.
example_en: The editor forgot to attach the chart.

trap: The person or matter handled follows de.
example_es: Uma equipe independente cuida da auditoria.
example_en: An independent team handles the audit.

trap: The subject matter follows de; tratar com introduces the person dealt with.
example_es: O capítulo trata de soberania digital.
example_en: The chapter deals with digital sovereignty.

trap: The abandoned plan or action follows de.
example_es: A empresa desistiu de comprar a concorrente.
example_en: The company gave up buying its competitor.

trap: Ceasing an action uses parar de.
example_es: A plataforma parou de recomendar o conteúdo.
example_en: The platform stopped recommending the content.

trap: The recent-past construction is acabar de.
example_es: O governo acaba de publicar os números.
example_en: The government has just published the figures.

en: to stop; fail to do something
trap: Deixar de marks omission or cessation; bare deixar has other senses.
example_es: O banco deixou de financiar o projeto.
example_en: The bank stopped financing the project.

trap: Attested omission tem ser; Brazilian obligation normally uses ter que.
example_es: A comissão tem que publicar uma justificativa.
example_en: The committee has to publish a justification.

trap: Do not calque English consist of as consistir de.
example_es: O trabalho consiste em comparar as duas versões.
example_en: The work consists of comparing the two versions.

trap: The object of thought follows em; pensar de asks for an opinion in restricted frames.
example_es: O ministério pensa em adiar a licitação.
example_en: The ministry is considering postponing the tender.

trap: The object believed in follows em.
example_es: Muitos investidores acreditam na tecnologia.
example_en: Many investors believe in the technology.

trap: Confiar governs em, not de.
example_es: Os cidadãos precisam confiar nas instituições.
example_en: Citizens need to trust institutions.

trap: Insistir governs em before the action or proposal.
example_es: A oposição insistiu em votar o texto hoje.
example_en: The opposition insisted on voting on the text today.

trap: The investment target follows em.
example_es: O país investe em energia solar.
example_en: The country invests in solar energy.

trap: Entrar normally governs em in Brazilian Portuguese.
example_es: Novos atores entraram no mercado.
example_en: New players entered the market.

trap: Location uses em, contracted with an article where the place name requires one.
example_es: Ela mora em Brasília desde 2020.
example_en: She has lived in Brasília since 2020.

trap: The place or condition follows em.
example_es: Milhões de pessoas vivem em áreas urbanas.
example_en: Millions of people live in urban areas.

trap: Use em for the field or workplace; para introduces an employer/beneficiary.
example_es: Ela trabalha em uma editora acadêmica.
example_en: She works at an academic publisher.

trap: Brazilian Portuguese normally uses votar em for a candidate or proposal.
example_es: A maioria votou na proposta revisada.
example_en: The majority voted for the revised proposal.

trap: Contar com means rely on or have; do not use em.
example_es: O projeto conta com apoio internacional.
example_en: The project has international support.

trap: The object of a dream follows com.
example_es: Os pesquisadores sonham com uma bateria mais limpa.
example_en: The researchers dream of a cleaner battery.

trap: The person or position agreed with follows com.
example_es: A relatora concorda com os especialistas.
example_en: The rapporteur agrees with the experts.

trap: Lidar governs com.
example_es: A lei precisa lidar com novos riscos.
example_en: The law needs to deal with new risks.

trap: Brazilian usage commonly selects com for the object of concern.
example_es: Os editores se preocupam com a qualidade do áudio.
example_en: The editors worry about audio quality.

trap: The collaborator follows com.
example_es: A universidade colabora com várias empresas.
example_en: The university collaborates with several companies.

trap: The chosen option follows por.
example_es: O conselho optou por adiar a decisão.
example_en: The council chose to postpone the decision.

trap: Use por for a goal or cause; contra introduces an opponent.
example_es: Os jornalistas lutam por liberdade de imprensa.
example_en: Journalists fight for press freedom.

trap: The route or process follows por.
example_es: O texto passou por três revisões.
example_en: The text went through three revisions.

trap: Attested por/para trap: an employer or beneficiary takes para.
example_es: Ela trabalhava para a prefeita.
example_en: She worked for the mayor.

trap: Purpose follows para; servir de means serve as.
example_es: Este painel serve para acompanhar os gastos.
example_en: This dashboard is used to track spending.

trap: Use para for the resulting goal or effect.
example_es: A medida contribui para reduzir as emissões.
example_en: The measure helps reduce emissions.

trap: Attested em calque: means of transport is de carro/de trem/de avião.
example_es: A equipe viajou de trem para a conferência.
example_en: The team travelled to the conference by train.

trap: Attested article omission: em + o Brasil contracts to no Brasil.
example_es: O pesquisador mora no Brasil desde 2018.
example_en: The researcher has lived in Brazil since 2018.

trap: Attested article omission: Brazilian Portuguese uses na França.
example_es: Ela trabalha na França para uma organização internacional.
example_en: She works in France for an international organization.

trap: Attested article omission: Brazilian Portuguese uses na Suíça.
example_es: O editor vive na Suíça há dez anos.
example_en: The editor has lived in Switzerland for ten years.

trap: A contracts with masculine o: chegar ao Brasil.
example_es: A delegação chegou ao Brasil no domingo.
example_en: The delegation arrived in Brazil on Sunday.

trap: Attested contraction: a + as before a feminine clock hour gives às.
example_es: Os ministros vão se reunir às cinco horas.
example_en: The ministers will meet at five o'clock.

en: to occur at the same time
trap: The fixed expression is ao mesmo tempo, not no mesmo tempo.
example_es: As duas votações ocorreram ao mesmo tempo.
example_en: The two votes took place at the same time.

trap: The fixed time-of-day expression is de manhã.
example_es: A coletiva de imprensa aconteceu de manhã.
example_en: The press conference took place in the morning.

trap: Attested para/por trap: a stated reason takes por.
example_es: A oposição rejeitou o texto por duas razões.
example_en: The opposition rejected the text for two reasons.

trap: Frequency is expressed with por, not para.
example_es: O comitê se reúne três vezes por semana.
example_en: The committee meets three times a week.
